problem.name: Signed graph clusterability testing
problem.statement_latex: For a bounded-degree graph with edges labeled $+$ or $-$, distinguish graphs whose vertices can be partitioned so that positive edges lie inside parts and negative edges join distinct parts from graphs $\varepsilon$-far from that property. Distance counts edge-label or adjacency modifications.
